purpose: Deliver a five-part company manifesto one statement at a time. The section is five viewport-heights tall with a sticky stage, so the visitor's own scrolling paces the reading and each statement replaces the last in place, making a long statement feel like a guided story instead of a wall of text.

behaviour.note: SCROLL-LINKED, NOT TIME-BASED: there is no timer and no autoplay. Progress p = scrolled distance / (section height minus viewport height), clamped 0 to 1, recomputed in a requestAnimationFrame on scroll and resize. Every value below is a pure function of p.

Section height is 5 x --slide-h (calc(var(--slide-h) * 5)). --slide-h is 65vh below md and 100vh from md up, so the scroll distance is 5 x 65vh on phones and 5 x 100vh on tablet and desktop. The stage is a sticky viewport (top = nav height, height = 100vh minus nav height) with overflow hidden.

Each statement i owns the progress segment [i/5, (i+1)/5]. It fades IN over the first 6% of progress (FADE = 0.06 of the whole range, measured from the start of its own fifth): opacity 0 to 1 while translateY goes from +28px to 0. It fades OUT over the last 6% of its fifth: opacity 1 to 0 while translateY goes 0 to -28px. Between those it sits at opacity 1, no offset. Linear, no easing curve.

Edge cases: the FIRST statement starts fully visible (no fade-in) and the LAST statement never fades out (stays visible to the end of the section). Statements are absolutely stacked in the same centred spot; only one is meaningfully visible at a time, with a brief cross-fade at each boundary. aria-hidden flips at opacity .5.

Pagination dots (5) sit centred near the bottom of the stage. The active dot widens 6px to 24px and goes opacity .3 to 1; the weight crossfades over +-5% of progress (DOT = 0.05) around each boundary. Dot 0 starts active, the last dot stays active.

Dark section (class 'dark' on the root), with a pattern-01 strip inside the stage. Text is centred, text-balance, 2xl size, strong colour. Statements may contain bold spans (the first is bold in full; the last ends with a bold phrase).
On /about it sits after a company section and before the team section. Its height depends on the --nav-height-mobile (64px) and --nav-height-desktop (72px) CSS variables.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Only one variant: dark stage, pattern strip, five statements, five dots.

statements.note: Exactly five: the scroll maths and section height are hard-coded to N = 5 (statements.length), and the observed content has 5. Statement 1 is a short bold line; 2 to 5 are longer paragraphs. Real company voice; never fabricate.

items.note: Observed 14 to 59 words for statements 2 to 5 and about 9 words for statement 1. Supports strong spans.

patternStrip.note: Pattern-01 strip inside the sticky stage.

motion.reducedMotionNote: Proposal only: render the five statements stacked as ordinary static paragraphs (no sticky stage, no height multiplier, no dots). The source has no prefers-reduced-motion handling.
